rules.seed_cohort: Absent seed pair; result is fresh and already in core projected concepts.
rules.target_cohort: Absent pair among core projected concepts; output is current target; target never input.
rules.conflicts: Never add or replace outputs on an existing core recipe pair. Competing candidate outputs remain separate choices for review.
rules.approval: Edge weights, graph provenance and structural eligibility do not constitute semantic or editorial approval.
rules.bounds: No new nodes, seeds or targets. The core is retained byte-exact. Candidate counts are not an instruction to accept every proposal.
